title: MAC FM · Saturday 3 October 2026
description: Good morning, MAC Fellas, and welcome back to MAC FM, your unofficial air-cargo radio. Morning, Alex. Let's dive right into the latest updates. Starting with pharma, LATAM Cargo saw a massive 150 percent volume surge on the Europe-Brazil lane. That definitely points to continued high demand for specialized cold-chain capacity down that South American corridor. Over in the Middle East, Flydubai Cargo just rolled out three B737-800 freighters to kick off its first scheduled network. Adding that dedicated regional capacity might really shake up competition for e-commerce and specialized shipments. And finally, Ethiopian Airlines just secured Africa's first deal for the Boeing 777-8F as part of a wider ten-aircraft order. A solid widebody investment to keep an eye on for long-term heavy cargo trends across the continent. That's all for today.

sources.title: LATAM Cargo Pharma Volumes Surge 150% on Europe-Brazil Lane
Flydubai Cargo Launches Inaugural B737-800 Freighter Network
Ethiopian Airlines Signs Africa's First 777-8F Freighter Deal
